rankings.summaryHtml: Vooch! Who wants to read about Victor Oladipo's injury or Elfrid Payton's tough baptism when Nikola Vucevic is racking up 15 points, 23 boards and 4 blocks as just the fourth player in recorded history to hit those levels in a season opener? The others: Bob McAdoo (1973), Bill Walton (1974) and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (1975).
